description: Draws a one-of-a-kind t-shirt design from a short idea in the person’s own words, in any language (3–140 characters), such as “a fox reading the morning paper”. For a shirt idea, a gift or merch. Makes four pictures in the shop’s dot-drawing style; returns the first as soon as it is ready, with the drawing’s id.

prompt.description: What the drawing should show, in the person’s own words.

name: draw_shirt
title: Draw a shirt from words
